text:
alana: ok this is a new one  garden gnome took out the outdoor junction box during a very enthusiastic yard rearrange. house internet went bouncy mid-standup. photos and a sad gnome attached.
devon: waitthe gnome unplugged your internet? do they have vendetta against streaming services? :joy: Did you call the ISP?
alana: called. they said a field tech might need to visit because the external splice looks shifted. i took a quick traceroute to capture the gap for the ticket.
irene: post the traceroute snippet, helps them see where it hangs. also, tape the box closed temporarily to keep critters out.
alana: here's the traceroute i ran right after it dropped:
```
traceroute to 8.8.8.8 (8.8.8.8), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1 (10.0.0.1)  0.734 ms  0.658 ms  0.601 ms
 2  * * *
 3  * * *
 4  72.14.205.17 (72.14.205.17)  35.121 ms  34.908 ms  35.003 ms
```
chris: the double asterisks look like the handoff point. ISP will want times and photos. good move filing now.
devon: temporary workaround: tether your phone and enable hotspot. if you have a small travel router you can plug into the phone for better NAT stability.
alana: tethered and back on audio-only for the rest of the standup. ISP scheduled tech for tomorrow morning. tradeoff: gnome threatens my yard aesthetic but my meetings are back 60a
irene: bring cookies to the tech! small acts of kindness make them work faster (and you might get a smile).
help-bot: reminder: for household connectivity incidents impacting work, open a ticket in #help with subject "home internet outage" and attach traceroute/pictures. company can ship loaner hotspots for urgent coverage.
alana: update: tech arrived, found the outdoor box lid cracked and a loose connector. they resealed and replaced a short run. full speed restored. ping checks stable now.
chris: victory! also: public service announcement  secure lawn ornaments before moving them.
devon: gif: animated gnome with a tiny hardhat :laughing:
alana: thanks everyone for the tips and commiseration. next meeting background will feature the rehabilitated gnome as a guest star.
